items.b: SHANGHAI'S Au99.99 CLOSES AT 1,004.21 YUAN, AND IT IS A RETURN NOT A RECORD
items.t: Up 20.65 yuan or 2.10% on a 983.56 settlement, on 7,268.38 kilograms and 7.289 billion yuan of turnover, which divide back to the stated weighted average of 1,002.84 exactly. The National Business Daily's own headline reads as a return to 1,000, and lists three prior reports of the price falling below it.

items.b: FIVE STATE BANK COUNTERS QUOTED ONE GRAM OF GOLD 16.60 YUAN APART
items.t: At 10:15 Beijing time: Bank of China 1,022.29, Agricultural Bank 1,018.00, ICBC's Ruyi 1,017.48, Construction Bank 1,008.89, ICBC 1,005.69. That is 1.65% between dearest and cheapest, four-fifths of the day's entire exchange move. ICBC's own two products stand 11.79 yuan apart.

items.b: GOLD WRITTEN BACK AT $4,634.20 ON THE TIGHTEST TWO-PAGE GAP THIS TAPE HAS SEEN
items.t: Kitco bid $4,634.20 at 06:05 New York time against TradingEconomics $4,634.46, a gap of $0.26 or 0.0056%. That is $9.70 or 0.21% below Monday's mark. Silver written back at $67.88 on a 0.13% gap. Platinum and palladium held a sixth session at $1,881.00 and $1,336.00.

items.b: INDIA RUNS A PROTOTYPE INDIGENOUS HPHT PRESS AGAINST A $594 MILLION IMPORT BILL
items.t: InCent-LGD at IIT Madras has completed trials of a domestically designed press and grown HPHT rough, under the 242 crore rupee programme announced in the 2023 budget. India bought about $594 million of rough lab-grown from China and Hong Kong in FY2025-26. Single source, Gujarati trade press, no company statement.

items.b: RUSSIAN ROUGH INTO INDIA HAS FALLEN $888 MILLION, AND SURAT SHRUGS AT THE CLUSTER
items.t: $1,195 million in FY2022-23 to $307 million in FY2025-26, down 74.3% on this desk's arithmetic. Surat's answer to a Yakutia cutting cluster is that Botswana and Russia have both tried before. The report gives no capacity, timetable or employment figure for the cluster.

items.b: 27 PLACES IN DALLAS FOR MORE THAN 560 APPLICANTS, AND 10 TO 12 A YEAR IN SEATTLE
items.t: One place per 20.7 applicants at Rolex's Dallas school in 2024. Qualified American watchmakers fell from about 44,000 in 1953 to about 6,500 in 2021, down 85.2%. Burdeen's is building a 7,000 square foot workshop for 2027. No brand publishes a median service turnaround.

items.b: BONHAMS SYDNEY RUNS 39 OF 48 LOTS AWAY, AND THE TROPHY STONE WAITS
items.t: Read live from the house's own board two hours into a 135-lot sale. Two Van Cleef necklaces tied the top at AU$55,350, both above high estimate. Eight lots showed an estimate and no price. The 4.74ct D internally flawless, estimated AU$120,000 to AU$180,000, had not been reached.

items.b: GUBELIN'S DNA MARKER WORKS ON MELEE BECAUSE ROUGH DESTROYS IT
items.t: Provenance Proof is marking polished melee from KGK Suisse with synthetic-DNA nanoparticles carrying mine, period and country. Deep boiling and acid cleaning damage the coating and polishing removes particles applied early. No cost per carat and no survival rate is published.

items.b: CORRECTION: RAPI IS REACHABLE AND PUBLISHES ITS INDEX LEVELS IN PLAIN TEXT
items.t: Our 11 August article and the record said RAPI and the Zimnisky rough index both returned no numeric reading and both printed unreachable. Retested today, rapaport.com returns 200 unauthenticated and publishes 3,881.34 for the 1.00ct series. The Zimnisky half was right; its status word is paywalled.

items.b: CORRECTION: THE JULY TARIFF ON ISRAELI GOODS IS 12.5%, ON A SECOND PAGE TOO
items.t: Our 27 July article on the Israel Diamond Exchange carried the same 10% figure corrected yesterday on the 23 August filing. The 10% was the sunsetting Section 122 surcharge; the measure that took effect on 24 July was Section 301 and Israel's tier is 12.5%. Corrected in body, dek, panel and record.
